messages:
Arjun: quick flag  noticed a scatter of accounts reporting that the console 'version badge' shows v1 pinned but the meter in cost-explorer attributes to v2. low volume but persistent. anyone digging in?
Leah: saw this morning. root cause looks like the SDK handshake defaulting to `Accept-Version: v2` for retries when a prior response timed out. fallback path doesn't re-assert tenant pin.
Marco: that header behavior changed in the SDK 2.3.0 -> 2.4.0 patch where we added optimistic upgrade.
Tanya: ugh. that explains invoices Billing pinged us about. Billing: any concrete tenants impacted or just noise?
Billing: ~7 tenants flagged so far, mostly small but one mid-market with 200k tokens billed to unexpected model. need list + traces.
ci-bot: rolling deploy record: sdk-service 2.4.0 at 1764547000; routing-proxy unchanged.
Arjun: mitigation idea: console shows an "Attribution consistency" metric on tenant page. if mismatch rate > 0.5% show a banner and offer a one-click "force-consistent-attribution" toggle which rewrites billing attribution to follow claimed pin for the invoice window.
Leah: backend note: we currently bind usage to `served_model` at token-ingest time. to retro-attribute we'd need to join traces by request_id and swap model_id in accounting pipeline for the window. doable but touches billing pipeline.
Marco: alternative quick fix: revert handshake change in SDK to honor `X-RW-Pin` header on retries. smaller blast radius and low-risk rollback.
Tanya: ops caveat: if we force attribution to pinned model while the runtime actually served v2, customers could see higher latency or different outputs than they expect. need product sign-off.
Arjun: agreed, product must approve remediation. propose: 1) short-term: SDK rollback + proxy guard to respect `X-RW-Pin` on retries; 2) medium-term: console telemetry + toast explaining discrepancy; 3) longer: billing reconciliation option for impacted invoices.
Leah: I'll draft a small change in SDK to re-add pin-preserve on retry. patch will be 1 week cadence; can do emergency revert if needed.
Marco: I'll add proxy invariant: when `X-RW-Pin` present, proxy must forward it hop-to-hop and not let retry logic mutate it. also emit `attribution_hint=claimed_pin` in trace.
Tanya: add alert: "pin-attribution-drift" if mismatch rate > 0.2% for any tenant over 1h. Pager goes to eng-oncall + account owner.
Arjun: UX copy for banner: "We detected a mismatch between the version you've pinned and the model that served recent requests. Costs or behaviour may differ. [Learn more] [Enable strict attribution]" Keep it soft.
Leah: also add a sampling signal: capture full request+response headers for 1% of mismatches and store in secure bucket for 30d. will help Billing investigations.
Marco: small implementation detail: use internal header `X-RW-Pin` (not `X-Forwarded-...`) and mark `hop-only` to avoid leaking. log `pin_origin={console|sdk}`.
Tanya: finance asks: if we offer invoice remediation, what's the guardrails? propose threshold: >500 tokens misattributed AND caused by our SDK/proxy bug within the incident window. Billing to review.
Billing: that threshold seems reasonable. will accept exported CSV with tenant, invoice id, token delta, sample request ids.
Arjun: owners: Leah -> SDK revert PR, Marco -> proxy forwarding + trace tags, Tanya -> alert+runbook+billing flow, Leah+Marco -> telemetry dashboard tile for mismatch rate. I'll write a short RFC and link to this thread.
Leah: ETA: SDK patch in staging today, prod rollout tomorrow behind kill-switch.
Marco: proxy patch ~2d with canary config.
Tanya: I'll create runbook steps including how to enable `force-consistent-attribution` toggle and rollback criteria (latency + error budget).
Arjun: last note: consider surfacing mismatch metric in tenant health score so account teams can proactively contact customers. cc @CustomerSuccess later. :thumbsup:
